title: Incline Chest Press Machine
summary: A machine incline press that targets the upper chest along a fixed path.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.6 for front delts (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.6 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly triceps total.

setup.text: Set the seat so the handles start at upper-chest height.
Press up and forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly to a deep stretch.

form_cues.cue: Keep your back on the pad
Keep your chest high and your shoulders down.

mistakes.text: Setting the seat so high it becomes a shoulder press.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less stable, More systemic fatigue.
Swap sheet: Less stable, One side at a time, More systemic fatigue.
